input:
; Standard macrotime protocol and source rewrites. This file is compiled with
; the ordinary DL7 prelude, then evaluated over source syntax before lowering.
;
; TypeScript-shaped row signatures:
;
; type Relation<Row extends readonly unknown[]> = ReadonlySet<Row>
; type NodeId = unknown
; type SyntaxFrontier = Relation<readonly [ordinal: number, node: NodeId]>
; type SyntaxForm = Relation<readonly [node: NodeId]>
; type SyntaxAtom = Relation<readonly [node: NodeId, name: string]>
; type SyntaxLiteral = Relation<readonly [node: NodeId, value: unknown]>
; type SyntaxVariable = Relation<readonly [
;   occurrence: NodeId,
;   variable: NodeId,
;   authoredName: string,
; ]>
; type SyntaxClaim = Relation<readonly [invocation: NodeId, macro: string]>

(: syntax_frontier
   (* (: ordinal int)
      (: node type)))

(: syntax_form
   (* (: node type)))

(: syntax_atom
   (* (: node type)
      (: name text)))

(: syntax_literal
   (* (: node type)
      (: value any)))

(: syntax_variable
   (* (: node type)
      (: variable type)
      (: name text)))

(: syntax_source
   (* (: node type)
      (: path any)
      (: start_offset int)
      (: end_offset int)
      (: start_line int)
      (: start_column int)
      (: end_line int)
      (: end_column int)))

(: syntax_claim
   (* (: invocation type)
      (: macro text)))

; GeneratedSyntax(invocation, output ordinal, template path) is the stable
; identity constructor shared by standard syntax templates.
(: GeneratedSyntax
   (* (: invocation type)
      (: output_ordinal int)
      (: template_path int)))

(: plus_form
   (* (: invocation type)
      (: output type)))

(: plus_operator
   (* (: invocation type)
      (: output type)))

; function plus(invocation: FormNode): readonly [
;   FormNode<[AtomNode<"<-">, ...Tail<typeof invocation.items>]>,
; ]
(<- (syntax_claim ?Form "<+")
    (syntax_form ?Form)
    (: ?Form item ?Head 0)
    (syntax_atom ?Head "<+"))

(<- (plus_form ?Form ?Output)
    (syntax_claim ?Form "<+")
    (nil ?Empty)
    (cons 0 ?Empty ?TemplateArguments)
    (cons 0 ?TemplateArguments ?OutputArguments)
    (cons ?Form ?OutputArguments ?Arguments)
    (intern GeneratedSyntax ?Arguments ?Output))

(<- (plus_operator ?Form ?Output)
    (syntax_claim ?Form "<+")
    (nil ?Empty)
    (cons 1 ?Empty ?TemplateArguments)
    (cons 0 ?TemplateArguments ?OutputArguments)
    (cons ?Form ?OutputArguments ?Arguments)
    (intern GeneratedSyntax ?Arguments ?Output))

(<- (node ?Output)
    (plus_form ?Form ?Output))

(<- (node ?Output)
    (plus_operator ?Form ?Output))

(<- (syntax_form ?Output)
    (plus_form ?Form ?Output))

(<- (syntax_atom ?Output "<-")
    (plus_operator ?Form ?Output))

(<- (syntax_source ?Output ?Path ?StartOffset ?EndOffset
                   ?StartLine ?StartColumn ?EndLine ?EndColumn)
    (plus_form ?Form ?Output)
    (syntax_source ?Form ?Path ?StartOffset ?EndOffset
                   ?StartLine ?StartColumn ?EndLine ?EndColumn))

(<- (syntax_source ?Output ?Path ?StartOffset ?EndOffset
                   ?StartLine ?StartColumn ?EndLine ?EndColumn)
    (plus_operator ?Form ?Output)
    (syntax_source ?Form ?Path ?StartOffset ?EndOffset
                   ?StartLine ?StartColumn ?EndLine ?EndColumn))

(<- (: ?Output item ?Operator 0)
    (plus_form ?Form ?Output)
    (plus_operator ?Form ?Operator))

(<- (: ?Output item ?Child ?Index)
    (plus_form ?Form ?Output)
    (: ?Form item ?Child ?Index)
    (int_lt 0 ?Index))

(<- (: ?Form expansion ?Output 0)
    (plus_form ?Form ?Output))
